title: Ritual of Dreamseeking
text: The Ritual of Dreamseeking opens a portal into the dream realm.
On a level 7x7 floor, arrange eight outer pedestals as shown, each holding a spiritual crystal. Place a ritual energy core at the center, at the same height as the outer pedestals.
Right-click the core while holding a bed of any color, at any time. One bed is consumed only when the structure is complete and there is room above it.
The portal opens one block above the ritual energy core. The core, outer pedestals, and spiritual crystals all remain to sustain the entrance.
Enter the central one-block area to reach the dream realm. Breaking the core or an outer pedestal, or removing a crystal, disables travel and makes the entrance shrink away over three seconds.
